title: stilbe verticillata
intro: Stilbe verticillata, commonly known as "False Holly," is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Stilbe verticillata include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
